title: IF with a number branch and a string branch returns a variant
query: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS ( T, "x", IF ( T[n] > 1, T[n], "small" ) )

source.quote: In that case, the IF function returns a -- VARIANT datatype
source.supports: the page shows an IF with a number and a string branch returning both kinds of value

source.quote: The IF function can return a variant data type if value_if_true and value_if_false are of different data types
source.supports: different branch types give a variant

derivation: n = 1 fails the test and gets the string; 2 and 3 get their own integer value. The values keep their types and the column is a variant.
